Saint Columba’s Hospital Last week was a very historic one in the life of St Columba The state of the art‘new build’ was occupied for the first time, with excited residents transferring from the old hospital. Also, adding to this moment in histo- ry, the Director of Nursing, Noreen Hynes formally retired at a reception in her honour on Thursday, attended by staff, family and friends. We all wish her ‘ad multos annos’ of health and happiness in her well - deserved retirement from her career and for a job exceedingly well done. Honouring Two Parish GAA Legends Eddie Keher & Fr Tom Murphy Next Sunday, November 29th, two outstanding GAA sportsmen from The Rower and Inistioge villages will be honoured in two separate, but conjoined ceremonies, to which you are all invited and welcome to attend. At 11.00am in The Rower , Jarlath Burns, Uachtarán Chumann Lúthchleas Gael, will conduct the official naming and dedication of Fr Tom Murphy Park, honouring The Rower’s local hero, Fr Tom, who passed away in Nov. 2022, having grown up in O’Murchadha just a stone’s throw from the GAA pitch. At 1.00pm in Inistioge , an t Uachtarán Chumann Lúthchleas Gael will un- veil the Eddie Keher bronze statue, immortalising our Parish’s and Kilkenny’s legend. Eddie, who wonsix All-Ireland SHC medals, is considered by many to be one of the greatest hurlers of all-time. So, take a break from the shopping and join in these wonderful celebrations honouring these two great friends and sporting icons of our parish. Inistioge

The Dog When God had made the earth and sky The flowers and the trees He then made all the animals The fish, the birds and bees And then at last He had finished Not one was quite the same He said ‘I’ll walk this world of mine And give each one a name’. And so He travelled far and wide And everywhere He went A little creature followed him Until it’s strength was spent When all were named upon the earth And in the sky and sea The little creature said ‘Dear Lord, there’s not one left for me’. Kindly the Father said to him you to the end.’‘I’ve turned my own name back to front and called you DOG my friend.’ In Memory of Baba, Fr. Martin’s beautiful friend Kilmacow Parish Priest: Fr.
